---
name: ecollab-failure-memory
description: Turn important E-Collab incidents and repeated agent mistakes into durable, searchable prevention knowledge.
---

# Failure Memory

Record user-visible, security-sensitive, or recurring failures under `docs/failures/` when that directory exists or should be introduced by the harness. Each record contains Summary, Root Cause, Prevention, Detection/Regression Check, and Evidence.

Before solving a recurring problem, search failure memory. Never use memory as a substitute for current evidence; verify that the old failure actually matches the current code.
